notes.title: Second Dreamer
notes.content:
Second Dreamer, a semi-sequel to this game is coming out soon.

[previewyoutube=buy6s9aQT_o;full][/previewyoutube]

This is the next console era, from NES to SNES times. Second Dreamer is an open world game, similar to Skyrim and the Elder Scrolls games.

Did you get all the endings in The Game Store yet? One ties directly into the beginning of Second Dreamer.

notes.title: The Dreamer Firework
notes.content:
Firework Simulator is coming out soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2271890/Firework_Simulator/

It's a simulator where you play with and make fireworks.

There's a bunch of different fireworks in it including First Dreamer, based on [i]that game [/i]from this game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42959576/bd74ced7ab53ee76b70a9f3cee77239ec5a783f3.png[/img]

It's a fountain type firework with purple sparkles and white crackles, here's a video of it:

[url=https://twitter.com/Echomune/status/1615435262502502403]https://twitter.com/Echomune/status/1615435262502502403[/url]

Follow [url=https://twitter.com/echomune]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/echomune/]Instagram [/url]and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2MxF-3onC1D-30z8lmd8nA]Youtube [/url]for upcoming stuff.

Also there's something huge related to The Game Store coming up soon.

notes.title: Theories
notes.content:
What are your theories about what's happening in this world, very interested to hear them.

You have to find all the endings for the full story of this game. [spoiler]The achievements can be a guide[/spoiler]

[h3]About the Future[/h3]
This part of the story is the 8bit/NES era. It's a prelude of what's to come. (The original title of this game was Prelude but it wouldn't work.)

[spoiler]Also what's the highest score you got on Steel Wolf and DaVinci's Flying Machine?[/spoiler]

notes.title: The Game Store. Release Date: Oct 4th
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZonjQB4cpRs;full][/previewyoutube]

Someone left money for you to pick out a game from The Game Store in town. Choose any one you want but do [b]not [/b]choose First Dreamer.

Instead consider the exciting Radical Skater:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42959576/43681c1ec9f54f594dcd14acf73c31531058a234.jpg[/img]

Make your way through the obstacle course and hit each radical ramp for a high score!

This is just one of the games you can choose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42959576/6218023dbba452d0bb2656bf3472f3e4fbc603d0.jpg[/img]

The Game Store comes out on October 4th.
